intended_object: For a regular (smooth) fan Φ in N_ℝ and a character m ∈ M that is nonnegative on every cone (m ∈ σ^∨ ∩ M for all σ ∈ Φ), the global monomial function χ^m on the complex analytic toric variety X_Φ(ℂ). On each affine chart U_σ = Hom(σ^∨ ∩ M, ℂ) it is the evaluation x ↦ x(χ^m). Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and Fulton §1.3 / Cox–Little–Schenck §1.2.
